IndianOil supplies fuels strictly in accordance with IS 17021:2018 specifications and all applicable quality standards. E20 fuel is a homogeneous, scientifically validated product specifically designed for safe vehicular use. Although ethanol is naturally hygroscopic, modern vehicles are engineered with sealed fuel systems to prevent water ingress. 

The introduction of E20 petrol in India followed extensive testing and validation by automobile manufacturers and industry experts. Since its rollout, there have been no credible reports of engine failures or performance issues directly attributable to ethanol blending. E20 is safe for use in all compatible vehicles.

IndianOil strongly advises customers not to rely on or circulate unverified messages.

🚨 Beware of the Air Pump Scam! 🚨
Next time you stop to fill air in your tyres, stay alert. A common trick is happening at some air pumps:

🔧 The man filling air will secretly loosen the tyre valve.
💨 Air slowly leaks out…
⚠️ Then he tells you, “tyre is punctured.”

Right beside the pump, another person (part of the same scam) will quickly offer to “fix” it and charge ₹200–₹300 to replace the valve — even though nothing was actually wrong.

🛑 How to protect yourself:
• Watch closely while air is being filled
• Check the valve yourself before agreeing to any repair
• Don’t rush into paying for “quick fixes”
• If possible, fill air yourself

👉 Stay alert. Share this post to help others avoid getting scammed!

featured_reviews.name: harshil panchal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Scammers! Avoid This Station at All Costs - They Are Cheating

I am writing this review to warn every single driver to avoid Mahanand Fuel Station (Bharat Petroleum) like the plague. This is not just a bad petrol pump; it is a systematic operation designed to cheat and fool its customers.

My experience was infuriating and downright fraudulent.

1. The Tampered Meter (Clear Cheating): This is the biggest scam. I clearly saw the meter already reading ₹5.00 BEFORE any fuel had even started flowing into my tank. This is a classic, well-known sign of a tempered fuel dispensing machine. They are stealing from every single customer by charging for fuel they never receive. It is not a glitch; it is theft, plain and simple.

2. Aggressive and Deceptive Sales Tactics: While the attendant was fueling, another staff member immediately swooped in like a vulture. He started pointing at my engine bay, claiming my car "desperately needed" coolant and lubricants. He was trying to create fear and panic to sell me overpriced products my car did not need. When I firmly refused, his attitude turned sour instantly. This is a pathetic and predatory practice aimed at fooling those who might not know better.

3. Overall Shady Operation: The entire environment feels dishonest. From the rigged meter to the staff trained to upsell and scare customers, it is clear that management encourages these unethical practices.

DO NOT fuel your vehicle here. Every rupee you spend is going into the pockets of cheats. They are stealing your money in two ways: directly by short-changing you on fuel, and indirectly by trying to bully you into unnecessary purchases.

I have already filed a complaint with the appropriate consumer forum and urge others who have been cheated to do the same. This station needs to be investigated and shut down.

AVOID. AVOID. AVOID.
